description:
Classify blood biomarker samples into spaceflight phases: 
    baseline (pre-flight), post_flight (immediate post-landing), or recovery.
    This tests basic pattern recognition in physiological data.

input_spec.features: 34 common analytes + 5 derived features (NLR, PLR, immune_stress, liver_stress, rbc_health)

output_spec.format: single integer label OR probability distribution over 3 classes

notes: C003 L-92 anomalies should be handled (excluded or flagged)
Class imbalance exists: more baseline samples than recovery
